title: Metadata Section Explorer
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: MicroSims
Metadata
Dublin Core
JSON Schema
Classification
description: A vis-network explorer of the H-Bridge metadata.json. A microsim root node links the five required sections and three optional sections; clicking a section fans out its fields with solid borders for required fields and dashed borders for optional ones, and a panel shows each field's type, schema requirement and H-Bridge value. A quiz asks learners to click the section a field belongs to.
audience: Teachers, instructional designers, learning-technology developers and learning-analytics practitioners (college undergraduate and professional development)

educational.topic: Sections and required fields of MicroSim metadata
learningObjectives: The learner will classify each field of the H-Bridge metadata.json under the correct section (dublinCore, search, educational, technical, userInterface) and tell required fields from optional ones.

dependencies: data.json (copy of the STEM Robots H-Bridge metadata.json)

accessibility.notes: aria-label on the network, checkbox and buttons; the infobox is an aria-live region; vis-network keyboard navigation is enabled; required versus optional is shown by border style and in words
